name: Construction TRIZ
description: Same TRIZ machinery with construction / civil vocabulary — structures, materials, foundations, scheduling, site and execution.

parameter_map.Stress or pressure: structural stress / soil bearing pressure / wind load
parameter_map.Strength: material strength / concrete grade / steel yield
parameter_map.Loss of substance: material waste / rebar offcuts / concrete spillage
parameter_map.Loss of time: construction schedule / idle crew time / curing wait
parameter_map.Quantity of substance: material quantities / concrete volume / steel tonnage

principle_soft.1: segment the build — prefabricated panels, phased construction
principle_soft.2: take the wet trade off the critical path — precast instead of cast-in-place
principle_soft.3: local quality — grade concrete by zone, thicken exactly where load peaks
principle_soft.10: pre-assemble and pre-cure before erection; stage materials early
principle_soft.15: dynamic shoring; adaptive formwork that adjusts to the pour
principle_soft.24: intermediary — sacrificial screed, bearing pad, waterproofing membrane
principle_soft.26: copying — repeat a proven bay module across floors and wings
principle_soft.35: change the material state — self-healing concrete, admixtures, curing compounds

examples: The concrete must finish curing faster, but accelerating the cure makes the slab brittle and prone to cracking.
The building must go up faster, but overlapping trades on the same floor creates congestion and rework.
The foundation must carry more load, but expanding it means excavating under the existing structure.
